introduction.value: Agents classified the author's documents, put figures into a Google Sheet, then operated the Swiss tax form in the browser and found two items that reduce tax; the author double-checked.

method.value: The author told agents where his documents were. They sorted them into folders and put the relevant figures into a Google Sheet. After a trial run downloading bank documents with a Record & Replay skill, he let an agent work the tax form in his browser while he watched. It entered figures, saved progress, added comments, and bundled supporting PDFs per section.

outcome.value: It filled the forms, including the tedious assets section, and found two new tax-reducing items. About 95% of the PDF grouping was right. He found a few small errors to correct, and overall it was not faster.

notes.value: He needed ChatGPT's $100 plan and used a week's allowance in two days. He estimates the run cost about $25, and he still checked everything repeatedly.

source_text.body:
Let an agent fill in your Swiss tax declaration
Agents classified the author's documents, put figures into a Google Sheet, then operated the Swiss tax form in the browser and found two items that reduce tax; the author double-checked.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The author told agents where his documents were. They sorted them into folders and put the relevant figures into a Google Sheet. After a trial run downloading bank documents with a Record & Replay skill, he let an agent work the tax form in his browser while he watched. It entered figures, saved progress, added comments, and bundled supporting PDFs per section.
How it went
It filled the forms, including the tedious assets section, and found two new tax-reducing items. About 95% of the PDF grouping was right. He found a few small errors to correct, and overall it was not faster.
Worth knowing
He needed ChatGPT's $100 plan and used a week's allowance in two days. He estimates the run cost about $25, and he still checked everything repeatedly.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Help me complete my [country/canton] tax declaration for [year]. First sort the documents in [folder or drive link] into categories and put the figures in a Google Sheet with the source of each. Then fill in the tax form in my browser from that sheet and tell me about any deductions I may have missed. I will log in myself, and you must stop and show me the filled form before you submit anything.
Original source: https://humanxai.substack.com/p/from-tax-assistant-to-tax-agent
